nodes.label: Chicken Time Flat Badge Logo (PNG)
nodes.description: Clean PNG version of the Chicken Time logo on a white background. Circular badge/emblem design with deep crimson red background, gold concentric ring border. Bold white uppercase 'CHICKEN' arcs across the top, 'TIME' arcs at the bottom. Central white analog clock face with black hour markers and hands (approximately 11:58 time shown), red second hand. A cartoon white rooster mascot with a white chef's hat stands to the right of the circle, waving with one wing. Black ribbon banner below the circle contains 'PIRI PIRI & PERFECTION' in gold bold uppercase lettering. Style is clean, flat, and illustrative — suitable for web/print use.

nodes.label: Flat Cartoon Badge Logo Style
nodes.description: Design concept: clean, flat, cartoon-style circular badge. Used in logo.png, Logo_v1.png, logo.jpeg. Primary palette of crimson red, gold, white, black. Minimal detail, web-optimised.

nodes.label: Rooster Mascot — Chef Character
nodes.description: Brand mascot: a cartoon rooster/cockerel character wearing a white chef's hat. In the flat logo versions it is a simple white chicken; in the ornate versions it is a richly coloured cockerel with teal tail feathers holding a hot sauce bottle. Present in all logo variants.

nodes.label: Clock Face Motif
nodes.description: Central visual motif across all logo variants: an analog clock face embedded within the circular badge, reinforcing the 'Time' wordplay in the brand name. In flat versions it is a standard white clock dial; in ornate versions the dial is bronze/copper with crossed spatula and fork as clock hands and chili pepper hour markers.

nodes.label: Tagline: Piri Piri & Perfection
nodes.description: Brand tagline 'PIRI PIRI & PERFECTION' present on all logo variants, displayed on a ribbon/banner element beneath the circular badge. Communicates the restaurant's piri piri chicken speciality.
